dedupe_keys.name: gaminanciu vartotoju atiduotos i tinkla ir suvartotos elektros energijos valandiniai duomenys suagreguoti pagal regiona

description: Gaminančių vartotojų atiduotos į tinklą ir suvartotos elektros energijos valandiniai duomenys suagreguoti pagal regioną is a dataset listed in data.gov.lt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by AB „Energijos skirstymo operatorius“. This data set provides hourly data on the supply and consumption of electricity to the grid by generating customers (NGs). The kit includes LUs that produce and use electricity on the same site as the Energy Distribution Operator (ESO) electricity meter. Data are aggregated by region, ie the number of LUs in the area. Coverage: AB „Energijos skirstymo operatorius“. The portal shows the English title as "Hourly data on electricity supplied and consumed by generating customers are aggregated by region" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is AB „Energijos skirstymo operatorius“. Its keywords include Gaminantys Vartotojai. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2025-12-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.lt). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-lt.
